name: Haruno Takahiro
source:
A detective lieutenant in charge of the Special Task Force who is in charge of the scene.

He's an honest and strict man who devotes his life to his work,
but he's insensitive to other people's affections and a bit of an airhead.

He's loyal to his subordinates and good at his job,
so it seems he's secretly popular with the Special Task Force.

His hobby is eating convenience store sweets.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/takahiro]Official site[/url]]
